|===

What each backend states on constant time, as the capability table read it:

* `hash2`: Boost.Hash2 1.92: its headers (boost/hash2/) state no constant-time property.
* `sodium`: libsodium 1.0.22: its headers state constant time for comparisons (sodium/utils.h) alone, not for its hashing, MAC, key derivation and password hashing functions (crypto_hash_*, crypto_xof_*, crypto_generichash_*, crypto_shorthash_*, crypto_auth_*, crypto_kdf_*, crypto_pwhash_*).

The default of `macs::hmac<digests::md5>`, `macs::hmac<digests::sha1>`, `macs::hmac<digests::sha2_224>`, `macs::hmac<digests::sha2_256>`, `macs::hmac<digests::sha2_384>`, `macs::hmac<digests::sha2_512>`, `macs::hmac<digests::sha2_512_224>`, `macs::hmac<digests::sha2_512_256>`, `macs::hmac<digests::sha3_224>`, `macs::hmac<digests::sha3_256>`, `macs::hmac<digests::sha3_384>`, `macs::hmac<digests::sha3_512>`, `macs::hmac<digests::ripemd_160>`, `macs::hmac<digests::blake2b>` and `macs::hmac<digests::blake2s_256>`: `hash2` on every target, whatever the program links; `sodium` only where the call names it, as its second template argument (<<hash-default-backend>>).
